label: Penang
short_description: George Town's UNESCO heritage core to the Batu Ferringhi beach strip.
intro: Penang's hotels in this directory split between two settings: George Town, the UNESCO World Heritage core on the island's east side with its shophouse streets, street food and the Gurney Drive waterfront; and Batu Ferringhi, the resort beach strip along the north coast. A handful sit closer to Bayan Lepas and the airport in the south. George Town suits heritage, food and city travellers; Batu Ferringhi suits beach-resort stays.
